howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Resend 邮件渠道接入 NanoClaw:复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建测试,然后把你的邮箱设为所有者并给你发一封欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Resend 邮件渠道,或在 /setup 安装过程中需要接入邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮件渠道
say.note: 会开始复制适配器并配置邮箱

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮箱收发
say.note: 完成后你会收到一封欢迎邮件

say.text: 配置 Resend 并把我的邮箱设为主人
say.note: 会运行 ncl 命令绑定你的邮箱

howto.what_en: Adds Resend email to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and runs the registration test, then prompts for credentials (.env), wires you as owner, and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw or need to connect email during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Help me add the Resend email channel.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and configuring mail.

say_en.text: Add Resend email sending/receiving to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: You'll get a hello email when done.

say_en.text: Set up Resend and make my email the owner.
say_en.note: Runs ncl commands to bind your address.
